title: Clinic pump supply obligation review
source_text:
1. Supplier must deliver 12 pumps by 2026-12-03.
2. Customer must pay ZAR 48000 within 30 days after acceptance.
3. Supplier must provide installation records for every delivered pump.

obligations.statement: Customer must pay ZAR 48000 within 30 days after acceptance.
Supplier must provide installation records for every delivered pump.

evidence.text: Supplier delivery note dated 2026-12-03 records 10 pumps delivered; two pumps remain unaccounted for.
Clinic acceptance note for the 10 delivered pumps dated 2026-12-04; it does not address the missing two pumps.
